answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tide of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
